title: MOUNT REEF DREAM TURNS INTO REALITY!
relevance_evidence: Music-only surf clip (no captions, Whisper small produced an empty transcript); relevance rests on metadata: title 'Mount Reef', uploader description dated 4 Oct 2006 (two weeks after the second half was installed) linking to the project site mountreef.co.nz, and a saved frame at 01:25 of a clean wave peeling past a surfer. The frame has no coastline, so location rests on title/description, not pixels. Not 'about' the reef in the spoken sense: no narration, no engineer/design talk.

segments.what: Whole clip: music-only amateur surf footage of the partially built reef (second half installed, 4 Oct 2006) per the uploader's description; clip was not watched end to end in this pass, so shot-by-shot content is unverified.
segments.quote: fast hollow right hand barrels and up to 50 metre rides on both left and right hand breaks

segments.what: Wave peeling left to right over the reef with a surfer/swimmer past the peak (earlier frame grab at 01:25; low-res 428x240 source).

transcript_source: local Whisper small (speech-to-text) -> empty: no speech in the video (music only); YouTube captions: none (manual and auto both absent)
gemini_claims: Gemini has no video for this reef (per_reef['mount-maunganui-reef'].new_videos is empty); QsyH6FEzDx4 is not in Gemini's list. Nothing to compare.
what_it_shows: Amateur surf footage of the partially-completed Mount Reef filmed shortly after the second half of the geotextile structure was installed (4 October 2006). Uploader description: a small 1.5 m north-easterly swell produced 'fast hollow right hand barrels and up to 50 metre rides on both left and right hand breaks.' Links to the now-defunct official project site mountreef.co.nz.

frames.caption: Low-resolution frame (source video 428x240) showing a wave breaking on the reef offshore with one surfer waiting in the lineup.
